argv: Map layers and markers (MapLibre RN v11)
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on a phone that had Busy streets on before this build, open Explore, then turn Storefronts off and on in Layers; zoom to 14 over a high street. **Expect:** Storefronts is still on after the update; its lines draw under the base labels and its street names (the `storefront-names`, `-turned` and `-room` layers, renamed from `busy-names*`) draw as before, none missing for a renamed id. (SF12, SF13)

argv: built by specs/storefronts (SF1-SF14, decision 0178) on the owner's yes, Nov 14

ops.body: - **What's good here? keeps its title** (steward S3, `specs/storefronts/plan.md`): the long press's action still asks what is *good*, while VISION.md's guidance is "where there is a lot, never whether it is good". G2 kept the title and changed only its line ("Where storefronts gather: X"). Recommended: rename the action "What's here?"; or keep it, and the spec records your call.

argv: Busy streets draw only for remembered areas
the layer is Storefronts since specs/storefronts (SF1)
ops.body: - **Storefronts draw only for remembered areas** and for the one read when the layer is switched on; a very large view shows only what is near.
